items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: All my life. We went to school together, fifth school... Him and I are the same age, you know.

ctx.x: Kind of skipping around a little bit. Did you ever work at Pete Lawrence? Yeah, I worked at Pete Lawrence.

When he was at Murray and Iterville. Yeah, I worked there. When I worked there in 19, about 17, 16, I believe in part of 17. How I come to work there, Joe Oliver had the job. Well Joe Oliver went with Ory's band at that time. See, now like Saturday nights and Sunday nights he played with Ory. Well he put me down there, Steve Lewis, Lewis Armstrong, Morris French, you heard of Morris French. Old man Valto, you heard of him, was playing violin. And who was on piano? Well Steve, I told you Steve was on piano. Must…
Well who was in Joe Oliver's band when he was at Pete Lawrence? Old man Valto, he was playing violin.

items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: And we had Steve Lewis on piano. And old man Valto on, you heard of him, on violin. And we played in their place on Saturday and Sunday.

ctx.x: Who were some of the other piano players around town?
Well, Steve Lewis and Tony Jackson. You knew him? No, I didn't know him. I knew of him. I didn't know him.
Did you know this guy Alfred Wilson?
